_comment: Single source of truth for the drift gates in the derived papers.
This paper now has three copies: the arXiv source in this repo, the
workshop version, and the SaTML version. Each derived copy trims a
different amount of body, so its main.tex cannot be hash-checked against
this one, and a correction landing here does not propagate on its own.
That is not hypothetical: the errored-run clarification landed here after
the workshop body was written and was missing until a reader caught it.
Each derived repo's scripts/check_sync.py reads THIS file from this repo's
committed HEAD, so there is one list rather than three drifting copies.
When a claim in this paper is corrected, add the old wording to 'retired'.
When a correction only matters where its surrounding passage survived the
trim, add a 'paired' entry so a derived copy that kept the context but lost
the fix fails loudly. Phrase every string so it cannot wrap across a line;
the checks flatten whitespace, but short phrases are still safer.

paired.why: a body that discusses the errored-run ceiling without this reads as 10 damage + 9 errored + 5 pass = 24 runs against n=16, which looks like corrupted data

paired.required: sits well below the pool mean
paired.why: the retained-cell argument depends on the corrected comparison, not the false superlative it replaced
